subject: M438 direct mapped-gate SAIF and PrimeTime annotation-only gate
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not derive any reviewed number from either M438 receipt JSON.
Do not treat VCS UCLI power monitoring as PrimeTime power analysis.
Do not admit power, energy, system speedup, paper PPA, or headline claims.
Do not modify docs/359_DATE终局冻结_20260813.md.
required_checks: Verify current inputs against exact SHA-256 records and verify the M438 manifest plus seal.
Prove the simulation netlist differs from sealed M431 only by one top-module rename.
Audit wrapper, testbench, assertions, UCLI scope, mapped netlist, and PT Tcl directly.
Recompute the frozen workload population from the three memh files, not from receipts.
Check all accepted functional outputs, reconstructed lanes, X audit, protocol status, and SVA evidence from raw simulation artifacts.
Parse the SAIF directly for duration, entries, TC, TX, protocol_error, and scope.
Recompute exact annotation and nonzero-toggle coverage from raw PrimeTime reports and check inconsistent objects.
Prove that update_power and report_power were not invoked and that no power number exists.
Apply both 95 percent gates independently before allowing a separate PTPX run.
Assign score, P0/P1/P2, and scoped GO/NO-GO.

decision_rule.go_separate_ptpx_only_if: exact annotation percent >= 95.0 AND nonzero-toggle switching coverage percent >= 95.0 AND inconsistent annotation count = 0 AND functional replay is clean
